affected_profile: read-only v5 whole-result approved-term audit; no natural-source ledger approved
expected_invariant: Each applicable source-line and ledger-term pair is counted separately and an omitted approved form identifies its ledger index, even when another term is omitted on the same line.

related_controls.condition: When one of two forms is present, only the other ledger term is warned.
The same two terms are checked again across a declared scene boundary.
A separate 1024-cue ladder still checks first, scene-boundary and final cues.

negative_controls.condition: One-character-different Chinese names in the neighboring cue do not count as the scoped terms.
An identical source term after its ledger scope ends causes neither a checked pair nor a warning.
A present reviewed or allowed Russian form is counted but not warned.
